32534-neighbors-life-stories-of-the-othe.title: Life Stories of the Other Half
32534-neighbors-life-stories-of-the-othe.creator: Jacob A. Riis
32534-neighbors-life-stories-of-the-othe.description: A book by Jacob A. Riis. Judah Kapelowitz and his wife sat and looked silently at the little dark room when the last note of his voice had died away in the hall. They knew it well enough--it was their last day of grace. They were two months behind with the rent, and where it was to come from neither of them knew. Six years of struggling in the Promised Land, and this was what it had brought them.

32853-in-the-cards.creator: Unknown

On this one, for instance, I hadn't been assigned an address yet and there were all sorts of changes in the place--buildings and streets where there had only been empty lots and sections marked off by string--and I just had to hunt until I came to our home.

arxiv-2009-00318.title: More is not Always Better: The Negative Impact of A-box Materialization on RDF2vec Knowledge Graph Embeddings
arxiv-2009-00318.creator: Andreea Iana, Heiko Paulheim
arxiv-2009-00318.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Andreea Iana, Heiko Paulheim. RDF2vec is an embedding technique for representing knowledge graph entities in a continuous vector space. In this paper, we investigate the effect of materializing implicit A-box axioms induced by subproperties, as well as symmetric and transitive properties. While it might be a reasonable assumption that such a materialization before computing embeddings might lead to better embeddings, we conduct a set of experiments on DBpedia which demonstrate that the materialization actually has a negative effect on the performance of RDF2vec.

arxiv-2106-12359.title: Discovery and modelling of broad-scale plasma lensing in black-widow pulsar J2051 − - 0827 Discovery and modelling of broad-scale plasma lensing in black-widow pulsar J2051 − - 0827 – A 2021
arxiv-2106-12359.creator: F. X. Lin​, R. A. Main​, J. P. W. Verbiest​, M. Kramer, G. Shaifullah
arxiv-2106-12359.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by F. X. Lin​, R. A. Main​, J. P. W. Verbiest​, M. Kramer, G. Shaifullah. We report on an unusually bright observation of PSR J2051 − - 0827 recorded during a regular monitoring campaign of black-widow pulsar systems with the Effelsberg 100-m telescope. Through fortunate coincidence, a particularly bright scintillation maximum is simultaneous with the eclipse by the companion, enabling precise measurements of variations in the flux density, dispersion measure (DM), and scattering strength throughout the eclipse.

arxiv-2111-04815.title: Parameter Conditions to Prevent Voltage Oscillations Caused by LTC-Inverter Hunting on Power Distribution Grids
arxiv-2111-04815.creator: Jaimie Swartz, Federico Celi, Fabio Pasqualetti, Alexandra von Meier
arxiv-2111-04815.description: Abstract As more distributed energy resources (DERs) are connected to the power grid, it becomes increasingly important to ensure safe and effective coordination between legacy voltage regulation devices and inverter-based DERs. In this work, we show how a distribution circuit model, composed of two LTCs and two inverter devices, can create voltage oscillations even with reasonable choices of control parameters.

arxiv-2208-09839.title: First post-Newtonian N N -body problem in Einstein-Cartan theory with the Weyssenhoff fluid: equations of motion Journal: Eur. Phys. J. C
arxiv-2208-09839.creator: Emmanuele Battista e1,e2,addr1, Vittorio De Falco e3,addr2,addr3
arxiv-2208-09839.description: Abstract We derive the equations of motion for an N N -body system in the Einstein-Cartan gravity theory at the first post-Newtonian order by exploiting the Weyssenhoff fluid as the spin model. Our approach consists in performing the point-particle limit of the continuous description of the gravitational source.

arxiv-2210-00996.title: X ⁡ ( 3860 ) X(3860) production in association with J / ψ J/\psi via e + ​ e − e^{+}e^{-} annihilation at Belle
arxiv-2210-00996.creator: Gui-Yuan Zhang, Cong Li, Ying-Zhao Jiang, Zhan Sun
arxiv-2210-00996.description: Abstract In this paper, we study the X ⁡ ( 3860 ) X(3860) production associated with J / ψ J/\psi via e + ​ e − e^{+}e^{-} annihilation at the next-to-leading-order (NLO) QCD accuracy, within the nonrelativistic QCD (NRQCD) framework.

arxiv-2211-09653.title: Exposing the threshold structure of loop integrals
arxiv-2211-09653.creator: Zeno Capatti
arxiv-2211-09653.description: Abstract The understanding of the physical laws determining the infrared behaviour of amplitudes is a longstanding and topical problem. In this paper, we show that energy conservation alone implies strong constraints on the threshold singularity structure of Feynman diagrams. In particular, we show that it implies a representation of loop integrals in terms of Fourier transforms of non-simplicial convex cones.

arxiv-2409-15271.creator: Jesse Jääsaari
arxiv-2409-15271.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jesse Jääsaari. We examine the distribution of zeroes of half-integral weight Hecke cusp forms on the manifold Γ 0 ​ ( 4 ) \ ℍ \Gamma_{0}(4)\backslash\mathbb{H} near a cusp at infinity. arxiv-2510-09589.title: Minimizing the Weighted Makespan with Restarts on a Single Machine
arxiv-2510-09589.creator: Aflatoun Amouzandeh, Klaus Jansen, Lis Pirotton, Rob van Stee, Corinna Wambsganz
arxiv-2510-09589.description: Abstract We consider the problem of minimizing the weighted makespan on a single machine with restarts. Restarts are similar to preemptions but weaker: a job can be interrupted, but then it has to be run again from the start instead of resuming at the point of interruption later.

plos-pone-0007466.description: PLOS ONE research article. The phosphoenolpyruvate: carbohydrate transferase system (PTS) transports glucose in Escherichia coli . pmc-10616574.title: OTHER-02 BRAIN TUMORS: CLINICAL PRESENTATION AT THE NATIONAL CENTER FOR NEUROLOGICAL SCIENCES IN KHARTOUM 2019-2022
pmc-10616574.creator: Arwa Nasr, Nidaa Ahmed, Mai Mohamoud, Montasir Mosaad, Zainab Amara, Reem Khalil, Safa Hamid
pmc-10616574.description: Brain tumors are intracranial neoplastic proliferation of cells. They are implicated in high patient morbidity and mortality. Malignant brain tumors are less common in relevance to other types of malignancies, yet they are enumerated as the tenth leading cause of death worldwide. Diagnosis of these tumors mainly depends on clinical features and imaging.

pmc-11388456.title: Poly(2-oxazoline)-Based Thermoresponsive Stomatocytes
pmc-11388456.creator: Roberto Terracciano, Yuechi Liu, Zivani Varanaraja, Magdalena Godzina, Gokhan Yilmaz, Jan C. M. van Hest, C. Remzi Becer
pmc-11388456.description: The design of biocompatible and biodegradable nanostructures with controlled morphological features remains a predominant challenge in medical research. Stimuli-responsive vesicles offer significant advantages in drug delivery, biomedical applications, and diagnostic techniques. The combination of poly(2-oxazoline)s with biodegradable polymers could provide exceptional biocompatibility properties and be proposed as a versatile platform for the development of new medicines.

pmc-11518572.title: Association Between Mycobacterium tuberculosis Sensitization and Insulin Resistance Among US Adults Screened for Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
pmc-11518572.creator: Itai M Magodoro, Aloice Aluoch, Brian Claggett, Moffat J Nyirenda, Mark J Siedner, Katalina A Wilkinson, Robert J Wilkinson, Ntobeko A B Ntusi
pmc-11518572.description: BackgroundType 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) may be a long-term sequela of infection with Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb) by mechanisms that remain to be fully explained. We evaluated the association between Mtb sensitization and T2DM and, via mediation analysis, the extent to which it is mediated by insulin resistance and/or β-cell failure.

pmc-11626183.title: MR1 presents vitamin B6–related compounds for recognition by MR1-reactive T cells
pmc-11626183.creator: Mitchell P. McInerney, Wael Awad, Michael N. T. Souter, Yang Kang, Carl J. H. Wang, Kean Chan Yew Poa, Mohamed R. Abdelaal, Ngoc H. Le, Chloe M. Shepherd, Conor McNeice, Lucy J. Meehan, Adam G. Nelson, Jeremy M. Raynes, Jeffrey Y. W. Mak, James McCluskey, Zhenjun Chen, Ching-Seng Ang, David P. Fairl
pmc-11626183.description: SignificanceThis study describes a naturally presented MR1-restricted ligand derived from vitamin B6. The molecular basis of the binding of pyridoxal and pyridoxal 5-phosphate described here reflects the ability of the MR1 A-pocket to accommodate different vitamin scaffolds. This ligand binds covalently to MR1 with moderate affinity and is able to activate reporter cells expressing a “pan cancer” T cell receptor.

pmc-11639662.title: Decline in diversity of tropical soil fauna under experimental warming
pmc-11639662.creator: Hubert A Szczygieł, Orpheus M Butler, Andrew T Nottingham
pmc-11639662.description: Climate change is exacerbating a global decline in biodiversity. Numerous observational studies link rising temperatures to declining biological abundance, richness and diversity in terrestrial ecosystems, yet few studies have considered the highly diverse and functionally significant communities of tropical forest soil and leaf litter fauna.

pmc-11709947.title: Pre‐diagnostic manifestations of Alzheimer’s disease: A systematic review and meta‐analysis of longitudinal studies
pmc-11709947.creator: Sedigheh Zabihi, Rosario Isabel Espinoza Jeraldo, Rifah Anjum, Christine Carter, Moïse Roche, Jonathan P Bestwick, Sarah Morgan‐Trimmer, Claudia Cooper, Charles R Marshall, Yvonne Birks, Mark Wilberforce, Fiona M Walter
pmc-11709947.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundAlzheimer’s disease (AD) is associated with a range of non‐cognitive symptoms that can be early or even presenting features. Better recognition of pre‐diagnostic symptoms of AD would support improved early detection and diagnosis.MethodTo identify possible prodromal symptoms of AD, we systematically searched three electronic databases for prospective longitudinal studies to March 2023, that reported the risk of AD diagnosis associated with non‐cognitive symptoms. Meta‐analyses were performed to assess the associations between a commonly reported symptom and AD.

pmc-12471209.title: Metabolomics in Multiple Sclerosis: Advances, Challenges, and Clinical Perspectives—A Systematic Review
pmc-12471209.creator: Jan Smusz, Patrycja Mojsak, Paulina Matys, Anna Mirończuk, Joanna Tarasiuk, Kamil Grubczak, Aleksandra Starosz, Jan Kochanowicz, Alina Kułakowska, Katarzyna Ruszczyńska, Katarzyna Kapica-Topczewska, Stergios Boussios
pmc-12471209.description: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a chronic, immune-mediated neurodegenerative disorder marked by inflammation, demyelination, and neuronal loss within the central nervous system. Despite advances in diagnostics, current tools remain insufficiently sensitive and specific. Metabolomics has emerged as a promising approach to explore MS pathophysiology and discover novel biomarkers.

pmc-12520217.title: Portal cavernoma cholangiopathy: A systematic review of current understanding, clinical significance, and management
pmc-12520217.creator: Elisa Pinto, Laure Elkrief, Virginia Hernández-Gea, Alberto Busatto, Kymentie Ferdinande, Alberto Zanetto, Akash Shukla, Marco Senzolo
pmc-12520217.description: Portal cavernoma cholangiopathy (PCC) is a rare condition characterized by abnormalities of the intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts and the gallbladder, resulting from long-standing chronic portal vein thrombosis (cPVT). These vascular changes often occur in the setting of non-cirrhotic, non-neoplastic portal hypertension. Its prevalence among cPVT patients ranges from 4% to 92%, with an unweighted average of 45.

pmc-12528680.title: Phytochemical analysis and enzyme inhibition of Origanum dictamnus L essential oil through in vitro and in silico methods
pmc-12528680.creator: Giuseppe Amato, Laura De Martino, Mejdi Snoussi, Vincenzo De Feo, Anouar El Hassane, Emira Noumi, Lucia Caputo
pmc-12528680.description: Origanum dictamnus L., is an aromatic plant belonging to Lamiaceae family. The aim of this study was to evaluate whether and how O. dictamnus essential oil (EO) showed inhibitory activity against enzymes associated with the Central Nervous System disorders and human metabolism. The EO was analyzed by GC/MS. Enzyme inhibitory activity against cholinesterases, tyrosinase, α-amylase, α-glucosidase and lipase were investigated.

pmc-12533262.title: Pushing the boundary of quantum advantage in hard combinatorial optimization with probabilistic computers
pmc-12533262.creator: Shuvro Chowdhury, Navid Anjum Aadit, Andrea Grimaldi, Eleonora Raimondo, Atharva Raut, P. Aaron Lott, Johan H. Mentink, Marek M. Rams, Federico Ricci-Tersenghi, Massimo Chiappini, Luke S. Theogarajan, Tathagata Srimani, Giovanni Finocchio, Masoud Mohseni, Kerem Y. Camsari
pmc-12533262.description: Recent demonstrations on specialized benchmarks have reignited excitement for quantum computers, yet their advantage for real-world problems remains an open question. Here, we show that probabilistic computers, co-designed with hardware to implement Monte Carlo algorithms, provide a scalable classical pathway for solving hard optimization problems.

pmc-12743098.title: Comparing augmented reality-assisted and freehand external ventricular drain placement: a multicenter randomized controlled crossover phantom study
pmc-12743098.creator: Jesse A M van Doormaal, Elisa Colombo, Jasper M van der Zee, Wouter D Maathuis, Maarten Bot, Patrick O’Donnell, Bachtiar Burhani, Luca Regli, Pierre A J T Robe, Eelco W Hoving, Tristan P C van Doormaal
pmc-12743098.description: BackgroundExternal ventricular drain (EVD) placement is a common neurosurgical procedure with high rates of misplacement when performed using the freehand technique. With augmented reality (AR), the accuracy of EVD placement could be improved by providing a 3-D overlay, guiding optimal placement using a virtual trajectory superimposed over the patient.

pmc-12859988.title: DANSE: a pipeline for dynamic modelling of time-series multi-omics data
pmc-12859988.creator: Lucas F Jansen Klomp, Xinqi Yan, Rebecca R Snabel, Gert Jan C Veenstra, Hil G E Meijer, Janine N Post
pmc-12859988.description: BackgroundUnderstanding time-dependent intracellular processes, such as cell differentiation, is key to developing new therapies for a wide range of diseases. Models that connect transcription factor activity to dynamic expression patterns are rare, despite the increased availability of time-series data.ResultsTo identify key regulators of time-dependent biological processes, we present the pipeline DANSE: Dynamics inference Algorithm on Networks Specified by Enhancers.

pmc-13127204.title: Integrated analysis of proteomics and metabolomics revealed mechanisms underlying age-related changes in pigeon breast muscle
pmc-13127204.creator: Ying Wang, Dongzhi Miao, Jing Chen, Haodong Zhang, Wanqing Li, Haiming Yang, Zhiyue Wang
pmc-13127204.description: This study conducted a comprehensive comparison of the metabolomic and proteomic profiles of pigeon breast muscles from 12-month-old (M12) and 28-day-old (D28) birds to investigate the influence of age on meat quality. The M12 samples showed lower L*, a*, and b* values but higher ΔpH, shear force, cooking loss, hardness, cohesiveness, and gumminess compared to the D28 samples.

pmc-13167262.title: Cannabidiol-Induced Tumor Cell Death: Molecular Mechanisms and Translational Perspectives in Cancer Therapy
pmc-13167262.creator: Chi-Yang Wang, Jia-Xin Tan, Lu-Lin Chen, Qing-Zhong Li, Jie Liu, Xuan He, Quan-Zhi Qin, Teng Deng, Guo-Tian Ruan, Yi-Zhen Gong
pmc-13167262.description: BackgroundCannabidiol (CBD), a major non-psychoactive phytocannabinoid derived from Cannabis sativa, has attracted increasing attention as a potential anticancer agent because of its pleiotropic biological activities and favorable safety profile. However, the mechanisms by which CBD regulates tumor cell death and their therapeutic relevance remain incompletely understood.

pmc-13301660.title: Mechanistic Understanding of Pandemic Dynamics: A Multiscale Algorithmic Framework
pmc-13301660.creator: Dimitris M. Manias, Dimitrios G. Patsatzis, Haralampos Hatzikirou, Dimitris A. Goussis
pmc-13301660.description: We present a robust, data-efficient framework for early outbreak assessment using multiscale analysis and Computational Singular Perturbation (CSP). This framework overcomes the shortcomings of the standard compartmental epidemiological models, which often struggle with parameter identifiability during the early stages of a pandemic, limiting their predictive utility considerably when data is sparse.

pmc-13338615.title: Clinical Performance of International and Korean Genetic Testing Criteria for Hereditary Breast Cancer: A Large-Scale Cohort Analysis of 2,188 Individuals
pmc-13338615.creator: Bom-Yi Lee, Hyun Jeong Lee, Jiyoung Kim, Dongwon Kim, Jiwon Jeong, Kyungah Yoh, Eunyoung Kang, Sung-Won Kim
pmc-13338615.description: PurposeInternational guidelines, including the American Society of Breast Surgeons, American Society of Clinical Oncology-Society of Surgical Oncology (ASCO-SSO), and National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN), have broadened the eligibility for germline testing in breast cancer (BC), whereas the Korean Health Insurance Review and Assessment Service (K-HIRA) criteria remain more restrictive.

pmc-13549705.title: The pathogenic effector PHYL1JWB interacts with ZjCURT1A to mediate jujube witches' broom‐induced photosynthesis impairment of jujube trees
pmc-13549705.creator: Fangfang Huang, Changfeng Ai, Chong Yang, Jie Feng, Meng Yang, Li Dai, Chaoling Xue, Hongtai Li, Jiaxue Cui, Xiangjie Qu, Jin Zhao, Mengjun Liu, Xuan Zhao, Zhiguo Liu
pmc-13549705.description: SUMMARYPhotosynthesis impairment and the accompanying leaf yellowing represent a prominent and physiologically critical symptom of phytoplasma infection. However, the underlying molecular mechanisms remain poorly understood. In this study, we identified the Jujube Witches' Broom pathogenic effector PHYL1JWB, which was previously reported to induce phyllody in jujube, as a key inducer of photosynthesis impairment.

pmc-13621935.title: Gastroschisis‐Like Defect in a Crossbred Bovine Calf: Anatomical, Clinical and Surgical Perspectives
pmc-13621935.creator: Mohammad Raguib Munif, Tanjin Tamanna Mumu
pmc-13621935.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Congenital abdominal wall defects with evisceration are relatively uncommon in bovine neonates. This report describes a gastroschisis‐like anomaly in a one‐day‐old female crossbred calf, suspected to result from the prenatal rupture of an omphalocele. The condition was characterised by evisceration of the pyloric abomasum and a portion of the small intestine through a ventral abdominal wall defect (involving the umbilical ring) without a protective sac. Clinically, the calf presented with generalised weakness, lateral recumbency and an inability to suckle.
